question: To buy a new apartment, Shweta borrowed ₹9,95,500 at 4% per annum simple interest for 39 months. How much interest will she pay?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Simple Interest formula: I = P × R × T ÷ 100.

Convert time from months to years: 39 months ÷ 12 = 3.25 years.

Substitute values: I = ₹9,95,500 × 4 × 3.25 ÷ 100.

Calculate directly: I = ₹1,29,415

**∴ Answer = ₹1,29,415**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹9,95,500, Rate (R) = 4% per annum, Time (T) = 39 months = 3.25 years.

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest: I = P × R × T ÷ 100.

 Principal (P) = ₹9,95,500 Rate (R) = 4% Time (T) = 39 months = 3.25 years Formula: I = P × R × T ÷ 100 

**Calculations:**

Convert time: T = 39 months ÷ 12 = 3.25 years.

⇒ Substitute: I = ₹9,95,500 × 4 × 3.25 ÷ 100.

⇒ Calculate: I = ₹1,29,415.

**∴ The correct answer is **₹1,29,415** (Option 1).**
